items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to creating the health
emergency response data system

summary: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system, which collects information and statistical data relating to public health emergencies in order to assist the department of health, other government entities, health care providers, and the public in understanding and responding to public health emergencies.
title: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system

items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No. 76
 
TO THE ASSEMBLY:
 
I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill:
 
Assembly Bill Number 5370, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to creating the
      health emergency response data system"
 
    NOT APPROVED
 
  This legislation would require the Department of Health  to  create  a
health  emergency  response  data  system  to  collect and report to the
public on information and data relating to public health emergencies and
services available during such emergencies.
 
  I recognize the importance of providing the public with necessary data
and information during a public health emergency. For that  reason,  the
Department  of  Health already utilizes a health emergency response data
system and data collected during public health emergencies  is  publicly
available through the Health Data NY website. The bill would be duplica-
tive  of  these  existing  efforts,  pose implementation challenges, and
impose unbudgeted costs that are not accounted for in the State's finan-
cial plan.
 
  Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill.
 
  The bill is disapproved.                       (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                               __________
